_note: Single source of truth. build.py substitutes {{token}} placeholders and expands {{BLOCK:name}} regions from this file. Nothing is typed by hand into the markup.

_provenance.approved_commercial_figures: TWO figures only: the 450 ILS + VAT hourly rate, and the indicative 20-40 hour range for the guided track. Both live on slide 7 (מסגרת התקשרות) alone. No total price anywhere, and no commercial figure on slide 5.
_provenance.founder_context: The ~16-DJ business is context supplied by Ben, not independently verified market data. It is not asserted anywhere in the deck.
_provenance.explicitly_absent: No market size, no willingness-to-pay, no development budget, no adoption or interview targets, no claim about iPlan's capabilities or shortcomings, and no count of potential users. None was supplied and none is invented. The deck is about the process for answering those questions.
_provenance.iplan: iPlan is named only as an incumbent alternative the founders themselves cited, and only inside a question to be answered — never with an asserted characteristic.
_provenance.hours_revision: The guided-track range was 30-45 in the previous draft; Alon revised it to 20-40. The deck shows 20-40.
_provenance.experience_years: Alon states ~10 years. An older deck of his said 7+; he has since confirmed 10, so the earlier conflict is resolved by his instruction.
_provenance.client_list: The sample-project names are supplied by Alon about his own engagements. Whether they may be named publicly is his call, not something verified here.
_provenance.tamkin_reference: The Tamkin/BDO proposal was read as a STRUCTURAL reference only: numbered circular stage badges over a titled band, and a full-width strip beneath the stage row. No BDO branding, logo, red, stock photography or corporate density was copied.
_provenance.photo: assets/headshot.png is derived by tools/prepare_photo.py (Lanczos resample, no retouching) from the largest photograph in data/. Alon supplied a 141x142 file first and a sharper 199x200 one after; the script picks the larger, so the deck follows whatever he drops in.
_provenance.deep_interviews: The guided track says critical depth interviews are run by Alon when needed. That is Alon's own commitment about how he works, not a claim about what Ben and Ofek can or cannot do.
_provenance.s5_first_person: Slide 5 switched from third person ('אלון מוביל') to first person ('אני מוביל') throughout, per Alon's instruction, and dropped the 'עצמאי/עצמאות' framing on both the limitation of option A and the advantage of option B — the claim is now about the SCOPE of external validation, not its overall quality or independence.
_provenance.s6_repurposed: Slide 6 no longer duplicates slide 3's venture-diagnostic questions (first customer, core pain, why-now). It now asks what's needed to tailor the consulting process itself: prior work, the decision they want at the end, capacity for homework, and any pending deadline.
_provenance.meeting_vs_mapping: 'פגישת המיפוי' (a forward reference to this meeting as a scoping event, on slide 7 and in the web footnote) was renamed 'פגישת ההיכרות'. This is unrelated to meeting.format_he ('פגישת היכרות ומיפוי'), the meeting's own name used elsewhere in the deck, which was not touched.
